question: Which remaining pieces of #97971 should stay as OpenClaw core work after current dry-run, token guidance, bind precedence, audit support, and the narrower #97970/#98022 path are accounted for?
rationale: The issue bundles several stable setup/auth/update/audit surfaces, some already implemented and others requiring docs/product ownership choices rather than one safe autonomous repair.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Open or designate separate canonical items for the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff UX, and unified audit-surface decisions, then close this umbrella once linked.

options.title: Keep as planning umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open only as a tracking umbrella while maintainers decide the individual scope and owners.

options.title: Close after canonicalization
options.body: Close this issue once narrower canonical issues or PRs exist for every remaining accepted request.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Open or designate separate canonical items for the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff UX, and unified audit-surface decisions, then close this umbrella once linked.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled current-main history across the central gateway/update/audit areas, even though ownership is shared.
